T3.decision: Skipped after a fresh full-paper audit. The only paper-proved candidates of T2-level difficulty are the arbitrary-tree, insertion-order, pairwise, plus/minus, and compensated-summation analyses, all of which have substantial corresponding infrastructure in frozen NumStability and would advantage L. The statistical results are attributed to Robertazzi and Schwartz, the accumulator and distillation guarantees are attributed to earlier papers, the experiments are not proof targets, and the remaining asymptotic or no-guard-digit comparisons are below T2 difficulty.
